title: doctor --hosts answers at once and stays cheap

question.text:
Done: Read doctor code and spec, ran the rule gate; no code yet. Plan: default run reads published results, `--fresh` asks the hosts.
Problem: Default `doctor --hosts` will stop asking hosts, so its line under `§6 Shared project bootstrap` must change; the issue names no rule ID, so the rule gate refuses. Approve that edit?
A4 needs the merged fix running on pds18; a worker here cannot reach pds18 before merge, so a task pinned to pds18 could show the Mac row after release.
1. Approve §6, A4 in pinned task - + a worker on pds18 proves A4 after release; - A4 leaves this task, which closes first ★
2. Approve §6, A4 unknown at close - + one task only; - close reads 1 item unverified and nothing tracks the pds18 check
3. Approve §6, grant pds18 access - + A4 shown on a candidate before hand-in; - new grant for this worker, unreleased binary on pds18
To answer: `taskq answer 2450.K` or comment `K` or the option text.
